tasks.short: Design hydrographic civil works and supervise construction or maintenance

steps.what: Read actual site surveys, hydrographic requirements, existing civil drawings and applicable construction constraints using native project and revision views
inputs: Actual surveys, current drawings and real construction constraints
outputs: Verified civil-work design and supervision context

steps.what: Design the actual hydrographic civil-work arrangement, dimensions and specifications in the existing design tools and check the complete final proposed design against actual site conditions
inputs: Actual verified site inputs and engineering requirements
outputs: Complete final proposed civil-work design with exact drawings and revision identity

steps.what: Review the completed final civil-work design and decide whether the exact drawing and specification revision is authorised for construction
inputs: S2 exact complete final design and actual civil design authority
outputs: Actual approval or rejection of that exact construction-design revision

steps.what: Issue only the exact authorised final civil-work design revision through the existing contractor drawing route
inputs: Exact s2 final design and valid s3 actual construction-design authority
outputs: Actual issued design revision and issue result

steps.what: Supervise the actual construction, installation or maintenance against the real issued design, inspect actual work and discuss deviations with site staff
inputs: Actual worksite, issued design and real contractor activities
outputs: Actual supervision observations, clarified issues and unresolved deviations

steps.what: Write the actual required supervision record after site work using native project and drawing-reference fields, retaining real observations and deviations
inputs: Actual completed site supervision and verified project/drawing references
outputs: Accurate actual supervision entry

steps.what: Save the completed supervision entry in the same project record
inputs: Completed actual supervision entry
outputs: Stored supervision entry

tasks.design: Use {DOCS} project/revision views and native {PROJECT} reference fields to reduce actual lookup and supervision-record entry. The hydrologist produces the real design in {OTHER}, the existing civil design tools; its actual independent authority approves the complete final revision before a separate contractor issue, and site supervision remains human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Matching current drawings and repeating project references creates clerical work around design and supervision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native revision views and reference fields can reduce that work without designing or inspecting civil works.
tasks.still_hard: Real site conditions and construction deviations require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the actual work departs from a defensible design.

ambition.what: Support actual design and supervision with less reference work.

reach.task: Review the actual complete design for construction release

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project revision views and linked references can reduce clerical work while civil design and site supervision remain technical responsibilities.

assumptions: Representative actual design-and-site-supervision episode, not a measured mix of construction, installation and maintenance. Survey and engineering staff produce existing source inputs; s1 counts finding and checking them, s2 actual design and complete author checking. No free accurate survey or ready construction drawing is assumed.

S3 must be the actual existing independent civil design authority, not a new invented approver or author self-approval. If real design rights differ, map that route before issue. The exact complete version exists first; any drawing, dimension, specification or revision change voids a1 and requires renewed review. S4 is its own actual contractor issue, small and fully retained.

Actual contractor construction remains contractor work, not saved focal labour; s5 counts real hydrologist supervision. No variation order, spending commitment, operative site instruction or completion certificate is hidden in discussion or the record save. Such actual actions require their own final artefact and real authority.

S6 splits actual required record writing from site conversation; its reduction covers verified references only. Try native features first; existing use has no new benefit. Ordinary same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated. Baseline95 focal/5 other-role points; shares are illustrative, independent of prompt priors.
unknowns: Which current drawing and project references are manual today?
Who holds the actual independent civil-design release authority?
research_questions: Observe a real design issue and site-supervision cycle and separate design, authority, issue, supervision and actual record writing.

already_counted.description: Actual source checking, design, retained design issue, physical supervision, actual record writing and ordinary save total91.7 focal points out of95.
Actual independent design-authority review retains5 points, equivalent to5/95 of focal baseline.

incremental.description: Maintain drawing-reference and project-view links beyond retained design and site checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete final civil-work design from s2 including all drawings, dimensions, specifications and revision identity; changes require renewed s3 authority

Low: current drawing revisions are not indexed together and all15 retrieval points stay manual; verified project/drawing fields still save1.8,1.8/95*100-1=.894, rounded down.8. Design25, actual authority5, issue1, physical supervision35 and save1 remain. A drawing-revision index constraint, unmeasured.

tasks.short: Monitor well contractors and enforce applicable activity rules

steps.what: Read actual well or boring permissions, contractor work scope and applicable rules using native site and permit references
inputs: Actual contractor scope, site permissions and applicable rules
outputs: Verified monitoring and rule context

steps.what: Monitor actual well contractor, exploratory boring or engineering activities and capture actual observations, measurements and relevant work conditions
inputs: Actual contractor worksite and current activities
outputs: Actual observations and evidence of compliance or deviation

steps.what: Assess actual observed work against applicable rules, clarify factual questions with site staff and determine the proposed enforcement response within actual powers
inputs: Actual observations and original rules and permissions
outputs: Actual compliance assessment and proposed response

steps.what: Write and check the complete actual proposed contractor notice using native site, permit and rule-reference fields, retaining the actual findings and required response
inputs: Actual compliance findings and verified site/permit/rule references
outputs: Exact final proposed notice including addressee, findings and required response

steps.what: Review the actual completed final notice, evidence and real enforcement powers and decide whether to authorise that exact notice
inputs: S4 exact final notice, actual evidence and applicable authority
outputs: Actual authorisation or rejection of the exact notice

steps.what: Send only the exact authorised final notice to the actual identified contractor through the existing notice route
inputs: Exact final notice and valid s5 actual enforcement authority
outputs: Actual contractor notice and delivery result

steps.what: Write the actual monitoring and enforcement case entry after observations and any actual notice, including the delivery result and unresolved response
inputs: Actual monitoring, exact notice and real delivery result
outputs: Accurate actual monitoring case entry

steps.what: Save the completed case entry in the same project record
inputs: Completed actual case entry
outputs: Stored monitoring case entry

tasks.design: Use native {PROJECT} site references and {DOCS} permit/rule fields around actual contractor monitoring. The hydrologist assesses actual observations and writes the final notice; the real independent enforcement authority authorises it before the separate {EMAIL} send, followed by actual case recording.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual site and rule references can be repeatedly located and typed into a notice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference views and notice fields can reduce that clerical work.
tasks.still_hard: Real evidence and enforcement powers cannot be inferred from a template.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish an observed deviation from an unsupported allegation and act within actual authority.

ambition.what: Reduce actual reference work within contractor monitoring and notice production.

reach.task: Authorise the actual completed contractor notice

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked site and rule references can reduce notice clerical work while compliance judgement and enforcement authority remain human responsibilities.

assumptions: Representative actual monitoring episode that requires a written contractor notice; no notice is invented for every site visit and no time mix is extrapolated. Actual permit owners produce rules and permissions, s1 counts finding and checking them, s2 real evidence capture and s3 compliance assessment. No free structured violation feed is assumed.

Native reference fields reduce copying only, not the actual factual or rule interpretation. Try existing views/templates first; features already used have zero new gain. Actual site discussion remains human.

S5 must be the real existing enforcement authority independent of the notice author; do not invent an approver or author self-approval. If actual delegated powers or issuing routes differ, map that real process before issuing. The exact notice exists first; any addressee, finding, cited rule or required-response change voids a1. S6 is its own actual send with fully retained small time.

Immediate on-site action, a stop order with different powers, formal penalties, or separate regulator filing requires its actual distinct authority and final-version action; none is hidden in the case note. Case entry is written only after actual monitoring and any actual send.
Ordinary same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated. Baseline95 focal/5 other-role points; shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt time priors.
unknowns: Which site and rule references are actually manual today?
Who has actual authority to issue the relevant contractor notice?
research_questions: Observe actual monitoring and notice production, distinguishing site evidence, judgement, final notice writing, real authority, send and case recording.

Actual independent enforcement-authority review retains5 points, equivalent to5/95 of focal baseline.

Physical monitoring40, compliance judgement15, authority5, send1, actual case entry9 and save1 remain. A permit-condition indexing constraint, unmeasured.

steps.what: Collect actual abandoned-well register entries, sealing requirements, contractor reports and current case status, verifying well IDs, locations, dates and evidence references
inputs: Actual well register, existing sealing requirements and real contractor evidence
outputs: Verified well cases and explicit status/evidence mapping

steps.what: Match actual well case IDs and required evidence fields, assemble stated programme status and flag missing reports, dates or sealing evidence without declaring a well compliant
inputs: S1 verified well IDs and actual explicit evidence/status rules
outputs: Source-linked programme status and missing-evidence exceptions

steps.what: Assess actual well risks, evidence gaps and programme priorities and choose the next case follow-up within the existing programme authority
inputs: Actual original well evidence and explicit status exceptions
outputs: Actual case priorities and follow-up decisions

steps.what: Coordinate actual case progress and clarify sealing evidence with existing programme staff and contractors through the existing programme call
inputs: Actual case priorities and real contractor or programme questions
outputs: Actual progress clarification and unresolved evidence requests

steps.what: Verify actual sealing evidence through the real required site or technical inspection, assessing observed conditions and whether further work or evidence is needed
inputs: Actual well site, sealing evidence and applicable requirements
outputs: Actual verification observations and unresolved sealing issues

steps.what: Write the actual programme case entry after coordination and verification using native well and evidence-reference fields, retaining real findings and pending conditions
inputs: Actual case decisions, completed coordination and real verification observations
outputs: Accurate actual sealing-programme case entry

steps.what: Save the actual case entry in the same programme record without formally closing or certifying the well
inputs: Completed actual programme case entry
outputs: Stored actual case evidence and status note

tasks.design: Use {PROJECT} and {OTHER}, the existing well register, to compare actual case IDs and required evidence fields and reuse verified references in the actual case entry. The hydrologist chooses priorities, coordinates real progress and verifies actual sealing evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual programme status and missing evidence may be assembled repeatedly across well records and contractor reports.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit well-ID and required-field matching can expose missing evidence deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: A complete field list does not establish proper physical sealing.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an inadequate seal or evidence gap despite an apparently complete case.

ambition.what: Reduce demonstrated repeated programme status and reference work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: well registers can match explicit case and evidence fields while actual sealing adequacy requires technical verification.

assumptions: Representative actual programme case-review and verification episode, not a measured allocation across procurement, budgets and every programme duty. Existing register owners and contractors produce case records and sealing evidence in their normal work; s1 counts retrieval, well identity/location checking and evidence mapping. New surveys or missing reports are not a free feed.

S2 requires actual well ID, location reference, required evidence item, actual evidence date and source ID, and explicit existing status rules. It flags missing fields and does not infer physical sealing or compliance. Try native register/project views first; existing matching has no new runtime saving.

S4 is real spoken coordination, not a written work order, funding commitment or contract variation. Actual contractor sealing labour remains contractor work and is not a focal saving. S5 counts actual hydrologist verification rather than accepting a contractor upload as proof.

S6 separates actual record writing from calls and inspection. The ordinary same-system save does not formally close a well, issue a sealing certificate, authorise payment or send a notice. Those actual actions require their real final-version authority and distinct gated steps if present. No extra completion report is invented.

Save share1 represents negligible same-system time, fully retained and ungated with no saving or author self-approval. Shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt time priors; no unmeasured programme-duty mix is extrapolated.
